title: Saaxiibkii oo ka jeestay
intro: Waxaad ku dhowdahay inaad daaha ka rogto sheekada nafta ku noolayd hooska nebinimada haddana dooratay waddo burbur horseedda. Qofkani wuxuu guri la wadaagay mid ka mid ah rasuulladii Alle doortay laakiin ku guuldareystay imtixaanka iimaanka. Waa kuma saaxiibkan lumay?
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa dad diiday baaqii xaqa, mana aanan ka hor imaan.
Waxaan guursaday nebi Alle, laakiin ma aanan la qabin diinta.
Markii ay farriinta gurigayga u yimaadeen iyagoo wata digniin, ma aanan rumaysan.
Xaaskaygii waxaa lagu amray inay magaalada ka baxdo iyadoo la socota mu'miniinta, aniguna kama mid ahayn.
Ciqaabtii ayaa ku dhacday dadkaygii, anigana waan la burburiyay iyaga.
Waxaa Qur'aanka lagu xusay tusaale ahaan gaalnimada, iyadoo ay weheliso xaaskii Nuux, Suurada At-Taxrim.

Waxay diiday inay aqbasho nebinimada wiilkeeda.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
